story: Karna was born to Kunti from the sun god before her marriage and set adrift in a basket on a river. Raised by a charioteer, he was mocked for his low birth until Duryodhana made him king of Anga. He stayed loyal to Duryodhana to the end, even after learning that the Pandavas were his brothers.
belief: Karna is one of the most loved characters in the Mahabharata, the tragic hero of generosity and loyalty. Many people feel fate and society treated him unfairly.
turns: He joined in insulting Draupadi in the dice hall. He lied about his caste to learn from Parashurama and was cursed to forget that knowledge when he needed it most. His loyalty kept him on the wrong side.
facts: He gave away his divine armour and earrings to Indra, knowing it would cost him his life.
He never refused anyone who asked him for something, which earned him the name Daanveer.
When Kunti revealed his birth before the war, he promised to spare four of her sons, all but Arjuna.
